Yes I am using ethpandaops images for both lh and prysm in Kurtosis Both built from the optional proofs branch Reference thread: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1457862042814779634/1457863224559927357 Great work! Prysm actually only works in the "nominal case". For example, if you try to sync a prysm node after genesis, it won't fetch proofs via RPC ATM. (In progress) whats the nominal case? All proofs arrive via gossip I think this is fine for first interop devnet We will do rpc sync in a follow up devnet do we wanna launch something more stable ? <@531934490826768418> To clarify, This means it will work for local kurtosis devnets where everyone starts from block 0, but a prysm node won't work if it joins the network after genesis or if it falls behind and needs to sync? Yes probably. Might be cool to land the no EL validators first? What do you think? If all proofs arrive via gossip **after** the block. ATM I don't memoize proofs received before the block and don't try to fetch them after either. So really it works if everything is "nominal" exactly Do we know when we would be able to have Prysm work in the non-genesis case? <@531934490826768418> will it eventually sync the network when old blocks are finalised by the network? btw do we wanna have a sidetrack for zkproofs in interop? what does sidetrack mean? dark corner office where we in secret meet and try to get things ironed out I think not because those are 64 slots behind? without letting Tim/Alex know 😂 as they wanna focus on epbs and shipping glammy Well, I think it will join actually, but without requiring the proofs, which is even worse, because it will consider non-finalized blocks as non-optimistic even without the corresponding proofs. Ah you mean actual interop -- Tau won't be there and neither will Manu I think 😄 ah too bad I won't be there... (Family wedding...) someone gotta tell this guy about priorities man Working on it, let's say Tuesday? I’m available if this is something we would like to do. I defer to you guys on what you think is best
